eligibility: All land-holding farmer families. Excludes institutional land holders and income tax payers.
benefits: ₹6,000 per year in three installments of ₹2,000 each directly to bank account.
application_process:
1. Visit nearest CSC or agriculture office
2. Carry Aadhaar, land docs, bank passbook
3. Fill PM-Kisan form
4. Submit with documents
5. Verification by state officials
6. Amount credited after approval
documents_required: Aadhaar Card, Land ownership documents, Bank passbook

eligibility: Families from SECC 2011 data. Covers 10.74 crore poor and vulnerable families.
benefits: Health cover of ₹5 lakhs per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization.
application_process:
1. Check eligibility on pmjay.gov.in
2. Visit empanelled hospital or CSC
3. Carry Aadhaar or ration card
4. Get e-card generated
5. Use for cashless treatment
documents_required: Aadhaar Card, Ration Card, SECC verification

eligibility: Girl children born in UP after April 2019. Max 2 girls per family. Income below ₹3 lakh.
benefits: ₹15,000 in installments at birth, immunization, school admission, and graduation.
application_process:
1. Apply online at kanya.upsdc.gov.in
2. Fill form with girl child details
3. Upload documents
4. Submit application
5. Verification by district authorities
6. Installments to mother's account
documents_required: Birth Certificate, Parents Aadhaar, Income Certificate, Bank Passbook

eligibility: Women aged 21-65 in Maharashtra. Family income below ₹2.5 lakh. Not an income tax payer.
benefits: Monthly financial assistance of ₹1,500 directly to bank account.
application_process:
1. Visit setu.mahabat.com or Setu Kendra
2. Fill application form
3. Submit with Aadhaar, income proof
4. Verification by tehsil office
5. Monthly amount credited
documents_required: Aadhaar Card, Domicile Certificate, Income Certificate, Bank Details

eligibility: Delhi residents with electricity consumption up to 200 units per month.
benefits: Complete subsidy on electricity bills for consumption up to 200 units per month.
application_process:
1. Ensure valid electricity connection
2. Apply on Delhi govt portal
3. Submit Aadhaar and bill copy
4. Verification by electricity dept
5. Subsidy adjusted in next bill
documents_required: Aadhaar Card, Electricity Bill, Voter ID

eligibility: All Karnataka households with consumption up to 200 units per month.
benefits: Free electricity up to 200 units per month for domestic consumers.
application_process:
1. Register on sevasindhugs.karnataka.gov.in
2. Enter consumer number and Aadhaar
3. Verify details
4. Submit application
5. Benefit from next billing cycle
documents_required: Aadhaar Card, Electricity Consumer Number, Mobile Number

eligibility: Women aged 21-60 from families with income below ₹2.5 lakh. Permanent TN resident.
benefits: Monthly assistance of ₹1,000 to eligible women from low-income families.
application_process:
1. Visit nearest e-Sevai center or apply online
2. Fill application form
3. Submit with required documents
4. Verification by revenue department
5. Monthly amount credited to bank
documents_required: Aadhaar Card, Income Certificate, Residence Proof, Bank Passbook

eligibility: Urban EWS/LIG households without pucca house. Priority to SC/ST, minorities, widows.
benefits: Central assistance of ₹1.5 lakh per house. Interest subsidy of 6.5% on home loans.
application_process:
1. Check eligibility on pmaymis.gov.in
2. Apply through bank or online
3. Submit documents
4. Verification by urban local body
5. Sanction letter issued
6. Construction with staged fund release
documents_required: Aadhaar Card, Income Certificate, Affidavit, Bank Statement

eligibility: Girl children born in Gujarat after Aug 2019. Max 2 girls per family.
benefits: ₹4,000 at Std 1, ₹6,000 at Std 9, ₹1,00,000 at age 18 for education/marriage.
application_process:
1. Apply at Anganwadi/ICDS office
2. Submit birth certificate and docs
3. Verified by child development officer
4. Benefits at each milestone
documents_required: Birth Certificate, Parents Aadhaar, Income Certificate, Ration Card

eligibility: All families in Rajasthan. Universal coverage regardless of income.
benefits: Cashless health insurance of ₹25 lakh per family per year. 1577 packages covered.
application_process:
1. Visit e-Mitra center or hospital
2. Carry family Aadhaar cards
3. Generate Chiranjeevi card
4. Use for cashless treatment
documents_required: Aadhaar Card (all members), Chiranjeevi Card, Ration Card

eligibility: SC/ST/OBC/minority students with family income below ₹8 lakh.
benefits: Full tuition fee waiver, maintenance allowance ₹1,000-1,200/month, book grants.
application_process:
1. Register on scholarships.gov.in
2. Fill application form
3. Upload documents
4. Submit through institute
5. Scholarship credited to bank
documents_required: Aadhaar, Income Certificate, Caste Certificate, Marks Sheet, Bank Passbook

eligibility: Unemployed youth of Kerala aged 20-36. Permanent resident. Graduates/ITI preferred.
benefits: Monthly stipend of ₹6,000 for 24 months. Skill training and placement assistance.
application_process:
1. Register on karmakerala.org
2. Complete skill assessment
3. Attend counseling session
4. Get matched with employer
5. Begin apprenticeship
documents_required: Aadhaar Card, Educational Certificates, Unemployment Certificate
